content.text:
I couldn't run `ls /`. The shell tool was denied because Claude Code is in don't-ask mode, which blocks Bash calls that haven't been pre-approved. So I have no output to show you.

To get it, you can allow Bash for this session, for example by adding a permission rule for `ls`, or switch to a mode that permits it. Then I'll run it again. You can also run `ls /` yourself and paste the result here.

I haven't tried to get the directory listing another way, since the denial looks deliberate.
